response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM matched), grouped AS (SELECT m.zoneregistry, m.insurstat, COUNT(*) as record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / t.total_count as fraction FROM matched m, totals t GROUP BY m.zoneregistry, m.insurstat, t.total_count) SELECT zoneregistry, insurstat, record_count, fraction FROM grouped ORDER BY fraction DESC, insurstat IS NULL LIMIT 10;
